checkpoints.description: [1/6] plan measured speed campaign: M1 array address strength reduction (array_sum), M2 binary_gcd/primes codegen review, M3 char_stream path, M4 many_params+nqueens, M5 residual small gaps, M6 docs gate + ADR + close

impact_assessment.why: contract: emitted-code changes only in a measured loop, never a semantic rewrite; dependency: the benchmark harness, differential IR oracle and 1227-test suite police the surface; concurrency: single-threaded programs, no new state; state: no state files
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: closes measured deficits - array_sum -25% vs C, many_params -23% vs C, char_stream -22% vs C++, binary_gcd -20% vs Rust, primes -17% vs Rust, nqueens -13% vs Rust; dependency: general passes (array address strength reduction, spill pruning), not per-benchmark hacks; concurrency: none; state: banner numbers in README only via gate records
impact_assessment.risks: contract: an unsound rewrite shows up as IR-oracle or twin-output divergence; dependency: shifting helper layout can regress the historic fast paths (ADR-058 lesson: inline read_char made it 78 percent worse); concurrency: none; state: benchmark history grows one record per honest gate
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: every milestone lands with the full suite plus a 9-round quiet-window gate, refusal at any regression beyond the 10 percent band; dependency: gate minimums per case guard mandelbrot<=16ms and tak<=11ms as pollution detectors; concurrency: none; state: polluted records removed from history before commit

[2/3] gate honest in quiet window: array_sum -14.1%, binary_gcd -11.9% (C twin moved same), xorshift -7.8%; flagged fib30/primes/mandelbrot/argv_walk re-measured interleaved at -5.4/-2.7/-10.9/-1.4% beating their C twins; ADR-069 + README scoreboard rows updated

[3/3] str_len/str_byte literal folding + differential corpus; suite 1237 OK; gate: registry byte-identical at 79af21f vs HEAD (SHA-256, all 19 cases) so the honest record stands; ADR-069 records the interleaved-arbitration and pollution rules; checklists: passed

impact_assessment.why: binary_gcd loses 15 percent to Rust on the data-dependent swap branch; a cmov select lowers it branchless and generally (any swap-shaped if), with refusals for the t-read-outside zero-read rule
impact_assessment.benefits: binary_gcd -16.2 best measured interleaved; zero honest regressions; the pass refuses any foreign shape so nothing else changes bytes
impact_assessment.risks: cmov on a frame slot is illegal (register destination only) - refused; the t-zero-read rule must refuse reads outside the if; flag clobbering by the scratch mov is a non-issue (mov writes no flags) but nonneg facts for the two slots must drop
impact_assessment.mitigation: refusal tests for the t-read/foreign-condition/two-statement shapes; differential corpus entries for both the fused and refused paths; interleaved A/B + honest gate with pollution rules from ADR-069

checkpoints.description: [1/1] verify: cmov swap pass landed (b51be22), differential corpus covers fused + refused paths, suite 1246 OK, ADR-070 + README row, honest gate zero regressions; checklists: passed
[1/2] failing-first: generalize branchless select family - single-assignment cmovcc (nqueens leaf shape), swap already landed; [2/2] implementation on 79af21f base + many_params stack-spill probe

impact_assessment.why: nqueens 24.1 vs Rust 20.2 and many_params 13.2 vs C 10.58 hold the two largest remaining gaps; generalizing the select/cmov family removes branch misprediction on leaf selects and targets the 7-arg stack-spill shape
impact_assessment.benefits: general optimizer rule, not per-benchmark hacks; eligible ifs lower branchless across all cases; expected nqueens -10-15%, many_params path toward C parity
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refusal on any shape not provably equivalent (side-effect reads, else, partial body); dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: cmov needs register homes - frame slots refuse
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first SelectionFusionTest; differential corpus entries cover fused and refused shapes; interleaved A/B on load spikes; honest full gate with 10% noise band per G-004

checkpoints.description: [1/1] investigate-first verdict: ADR-071 - all three baselines fold many_params to a compile-time constant (mains are bare prints), so the gap is an unfair twin, not codegen; README rows + losses list synced; cairn-cmov closed (bd8f112); suite 1254 OK; no emitted-bytes change this turn; checklists: passed

[1/3] failing-first tests: read_char fast path fuses into the call site (cursor/count rip loads, movzx from buffer, in-place cursor increment; drain beyond them calls the helper); [2/3] codegen implementation in _emit_call with the helper's exact clobber contract; [3/3] interleaved A/B on char_stream + honest gate + ADR-072 + README sync

impact_assessment.why: char_stream is the last large honest gap (12.7 vs C 10.4, -18%): each byte costs a call/ret plus the helper's two rip-lea/load pairs and cursor re-store; ADR-058's full-inline refusal covered the refill path being inline, not the fast path - fusing only the fast path with a drain call keeps refill out of line while cutting the per-byte path from ~15 uops to ~8
impact_assessment.benefits: general per-call-site win for every read_char loop, not a benchmark special case; expected char_stream -20-35 percent; argv/str paths untouched; the helper stays the drain and EOF path so semantics and byte streams are unchanged
impact_assessment.risks: contract: emitted rax answer must be byte-identical for have/drain/EOF paths, and the c<0 EOF test must keep hiding -1 (differential corpus + e2e stdout equality bind this); dependency: none new; concurrency: none - single-threaded stdin; state: cursor updates become an in-place memory increment вместо add+store, count/cursor ripples stay static
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first ReadFuseTest (fused site has no call on the hot path, refusals keep it), corpus cases cover fused loop, EOF break, and drain rollover past 64KiB; interleaved A/B old-vs-new same seconds, 9 rounds best-of-3; honest full gate with the 10 percent noise band per G-004; README row + ADR-072 same commit per ADR-064 law
